purpose: Common Minimum Feature Schema — the one data contract the right-panel editor reads. See brain/research/common_feature_schema.md.

canonical_fields.id: stable feature id (machine; never blank where derivable)
canonical_fields.name: display name / title — the field the editor's Name input writes
canonical_fields.kind: class of thing (trail, building, cemetery, poi, callout, road, water, contour, landcover, ...)
canonical_fields.source_file: the served file this feature bakes to — the editor Source tab reads it directly instead of reverse-mapping the live MapLibre source id (named layers only; machine/coverage layers stay lean)

facets._note: Tier-3, type-specific. Additive: emitted on a feature only where a value exists, alongside the preserved original key. Not every feature carries every facet.
facets.difficulty: trails — easy / moderate / difficult (park-map color; catalog fills where the feature has none)
facets.category: POIs — proper-noun category, e.g. Pavilion (machine coverage layers keep their sub-kind as the preserved `class` key, not stamped per feature)
facets.facility_role: buildings — the facility role lifted out of `status` (Pavilion / Front office / ...)
facets.revisit_note: what info is still owed (from the poi-index), kept auditable on the feature

sidecars.aop_trail_catalog.json: trail name + description + difficulty, joined by trail_number == number
sidecars.aop_poi_index.json: building/cemetery/visitor description (blurb) + revisit_note, joined by match{} fields

rebake.mode: additive (canonical fields prepended; facets next; original keys preserved)
rebake.machine_layers: id + kind per feature (name/status crosswalked where a physical key exists); provenance is layer-level (below)
rebake.sidecar_joins: trail catalog + poi-index folded into name/description/facets at bake time (read live from website/data/, not raw/)
rebake.not_owned: publish.geojson is DB-baked by export_publish_geojson.sh and intentionally not re-baked here

collection_meta.note: Default editorPois loaded into aop_editor_pois_v1 on a fresh install or Reset viewer. Update workflow: draw → Export GeoJSON in the Map editor section → replace this file with the downloaded aop_editor_features.geojson → commit. Every feature gains properties.source = aop_editor_seed_v1 at load time. The optional seed_tag property writes a #tag binding into aop_feature_tags_v1 for the matching feature id; existing bindings on other layers carrying the same tag are stripped (the seed wins).
